Cass: Quick follow-up from runtime Q&A — collecting final clarifications for the roadmap doc.

Ravi: TL;DR answers from runtime:
- Microbatch defaults: interactive chat -> max_batch=8 (can go down to 4 for ultra-low latency); throughput routes -> 64/128 depending on GPU.
- KV cache: per-session pin for first 2-5 minutes, then best-effort shared-prefix cache. Eviction = TTL(30m) + size-LRU. Not a source of truth.
- Canary ownership: runtime schedules; SRE can force emergency rollback. Automated fallback routes to compatible quantized variants on sustained latency breaches.

Elena: Quick perf snapshots (staging pool theta):
- chat batch=8 -> p50 11ms, p95 44ms, p99 155ms
- chat batch=16 -> p50 16ms, p95 76ms, p99 290ms
- embeddings batch=128 -> p50 210ms, p95 700ms
Note: enabling prewarm for long-context routes reduced p99 by ~25% in tests.

Theo: Minimal canary snippet for the roadmap doc (paste into ops section):
```
canary:
  traffic_fraction: 0.05
  duration_minutes: 30
  trace_sample_rate: 1.0
  fallback_policy:
    latency_threshold_ms: 500
    consecutive_window_seconds: 30
    fallback_variant: quantized-stable
```

OpsBot: Canary scheduled: canary/2334567001 at 2026-05-15T16:00:00Z. Alerts: runtime-canary-latency, runtime-canary-errors.

Cass: Perfect. Ravi/Elena — please drop links to the staging dashboard and the rollback playbook so I can finish the notes. Also if anyone has representative prewarm prompts (short convo, long ~1500 tokens, embedding batch) paste them here.

Ravi: Staging dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/theta/runtime-batching-staging
Rollback playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/playbooks/runtime-rollback
Prewarm prompts: short: "Summarize this chat in one sentence." long: 1500-token policy fragment (repeat allowed). embeddings: 128 small json docs.

Elena: I'll run the canary and post raw histograms in this thread once complete.

Cass: Thanks all — I'll merge into the roadmap doc and tag SRE for the tabletop. Closing follow-up; will ping when notes are live. :white_check_mark:
